Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: A family or group trip containing members and expenses.

baseCurrency.description: Base currency code (e.g., INR, USD, EUR)

joinCode.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric code to join the trip

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the trip was created

joinedAt.description: Timestamp when the member joined the trip

role.description: Role in the group (e.g. Organizer, Member)

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An expense item recorded in a trip stored in integer minor units.

title.description: Title or description of the expense

amount.description: Amount spent in integer minor units (e.g. cents/paise)

category.description: Expense category (Food, Stay, Travel, Fuel, Shopping, Tickets, Other)

date.description: Date of expense formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

paidBy.description: Member ID of the member who paid

createdBy.description: UID of the user who recorded the expense

currency.description: Currency code of the original payment (e.g. USD, EUR, INR)

originalAmount.description: Original amount in minor units of the foreign currency

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate from foreign currency to trip base currency

receiptImage.description: Base64 data URL string of compressed receipt photo (<= 800px max dim, 0.6 quality)

Settlement.title: Settlement
Settlement.description: Settled status for a simplified debt payment between two members.

isSettled.description: Whether the debt payment is marked as settled

/trips/{tripId}/members/{memberId}.description: Subcollection storing members of the trip.

/trips/{tripId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Subcollection storing expenses belonging to the trip.

/trips/{tripId}/settlements/{settlementI.description: Subcollection storing settled toggle states for debt payments.
